name: Qabila Games
description: Level up your game with Qabila Games.
story: Qabila Games is a Saudi Arabian-based gaming company focused on developing and publishing mobile games tailored to the Middle Eastern market. Recognizing the growing popularity of esports and motorsport in the region, Qabila Games seeks to connect with a young, tech-savvy audience and promote its brand through motorsport sponsorships. They believe a partnership with a promising team will increase brand awareness and drive user engagement.
